CrawlerCommandInterpreter comment: 'I interpret a sequence of commands, telling a SurveyCrawler what to do with each one of them.
A digit repeats the command right before it two more times than the digit value, so ''a0'' advances three times.
I interpret one command at a time instead of reading them all first, so that the commands before an invalid one are executed.'.

GuardedRun comment: 'I execute the commands of a guarded run, remembering the opposite of every movement the crawler makes.
When something goes wrong I apply those opposite movements in reverse order, leaving the crawler where it was when I started, and I let the error continue to its handler.
I do not let the crawler move on silt because I would not be able to undo an unpredictable movement.'.

SiltGround comment: 'I am the ground where the crawler slides an unpredictable number of cells, up to my sliding limit, in the direction it was moving.'.

SeabedSonar comment: 'I know the ground the crawler will end up on at each position of the seabed. Every position I do not know about is firm sand.'.

PredeterminedRandom comment: 'I answer the number I was created with, so that the distance a crawler slides on silt can be predicted while testing.'.
